register: Informal-polite 你 throughout (about 350 strings vs 130 with 您), which is what mainland consumer apps use; 您 strings and strings mixing 你/您 are flagged. Buttons and menu items are bare verb or noun phrases (添加网站, 保存), sentences end in full-width 。, and 请 is fine for instructions.

avoid: 报道 (when it means a NewsBlur story)
内容 (when it replaces a countable story)
terms.note: Catalog majority (about 880 strings) is 文章; 故事 (about 155) reads as 'tale/fairy story' and 报道 as 'news report'. Counter: N 篇文章. 'News coverage' or 'widely covered topics' may stay 报道. Also avoid where it means this concept: 故事.
Counter: N 个网站. 'site-wide' → 全站 is fine.
Counter: N 个订阅源. 'RSS feed' → RSS 订阅源 or RSS 源 (both standard). 'Feed view' → 订阅源视图.
Next unread story → 下一篇未读文章.

标为已读 tolerated in tight space. 'Read Stories' (the folder of stories already read) is 已读文章, never 阅读文章/阅读故事 (imperative 'read stories'). Siri/Spotlight 'Read %@' opens a feed to read it: 阅读 %@, not 标记为已读. 'Mark newer/older as read' → 将较新/较早的文章标记为已读.

terms.use: 保存 / 已保存的文章
terms.note: Save story → 保存文章; Saved Stories → 已保存的文章; unsave → 取消保存.

terms.use: 分享 / 已分享 / 分享的文章
terms.note: Shared Stories → 分享的文章; Global Shared Stories → 全局分享的文章; 共享 is reserved for shared accounts or data.

avoid: 博客 / 个人博客 (loses the product name)
terms.note: Product name kept in Latin script with a capital B; Chinese has no plural.

avoid: 智能分类器 (for the trainer itself)
terms.note: Train (button) → 训练; training → 训练; Intelligence Training → 智能训练; Train this site/story → 训练此网站/此文章; Story trainer → 文章训练器. Also avoid where it means this concept: 智能功能.
Catalog's main UI labels use 聚焦: the slider is 全部 / 未读 / 聚焦, Focus stories → 聚焦文章, Focus view → 聚焦视图, Unread + Focus → 未读 + 聚焦. The plain verb 'focus on what matters' may stay 专注于 in prose.

avoid: 赞 / 踩 for the classifier states
terms.note: Super dislike → 强烈不喜欢. Thumbs up/down in marketing prose may stay 点赞/点踩. The trainer's 'beats' means Like outranks Dislike: 喜欢 > 不喜欢.
Prompt classifier → 提示分类器; Regex classifiers → 正则表达式分类器; scoped → 限定范围的分类器.

terms.use: 高级版 / 高级归档版 / 高级专业版 / 归档版 / 专业版
avoid: Premium / Premium Archive / Premium Pro / Archive / Pro (Latin)
高级归档 / 高级存档 / 高级版归档 (without 版, reads as a feature)
terms.note: Premium → 高级版; Premium Archive → 高级归档版; Premium Pro → 高级专业版; the short names Archive / Pro → 归档版 / 专业版; plan/tier → 套餐 (avoid 方案 for a pricing plan). The story archive itself is 归档 (avoid 存档, 档案 for NewsBlur's archive).
Preferences → 偏好设置 on all platforms; Settings → 设置.
Feed subscribers → 订阅者; paying premium subscribers → 订阅用户 is fine.
Lowercase 'your river' → 新闻流 or 文章流.

avoid: 网站所有文章 (read as 'all stories of the site')
terms.note: It is the river of every subscribed site, not all stories of one site.
Catalog majority.

terms.use: 邮件简报 / 电子邮件简报
terms.note: 新闻简报 (catalog's most common form) is tolerated; the outliers above are flagged.

terms.use: 关注 / 关注者 / 好友
terms.note: I'm Following → 我关注的人; Following Me → 关注我的人 (must be distinguishable). Ask AI follow-up → 追问.

avoid: 静音 (for sites, feeds and folders)
terms.note: Muting a site stops it showing in the reader; the Mute Sites screen and most site strings use 屏蔽. 静音 stays for audio.
Sites that publish rarely, not sites the reader rarely sees. In prose 更新较少的网站 / 不常更新的网站 is fine.

terms.concept: Good Reads / Long Reads / Widely Read
terms.use: 优质阅读 / 长篇阅读 / 广受阅读的文章
avoid: 优质推荐 (for the folder name)
热门文章 (that is Top stories)
terms.note: Good Reads is a folder of good stories, not books.

terms.use: 订阅源视图 / 文本视图 / 文章视图 / 原始视图
terms.note: Original site → 原始网站 (原网站 tolerated).

avoid: AI 问答 (as the feature name)
terms.note: Full sentences like 向 AI 提问 are fine when they are not the feature name.

terms.use: 账户 / 登录 / 退出登录 / 注册 / 创建账户
avoid: 账号 (catalog majority is 账户)
terms.note: Sign in and Log in → 登录.

terms.use: 电子邮件 / 邮箱 / 密码
terms.note: 邮箱 for an address field is fine.

terms.use: 键盘快捷键 / 快捷键

terms.note: Also avoid where it means this concept: 网页订阅.
聚合 for 'clustered' is tolerated in prose.

terms.use: Full-width ，。：；？！（）“” in Chinese text; one space between Chinese and Latin words, numbers and placeholders; no space next to full-width punctuation; ellipsis …
avoid: missing space around Latin words or placeholders
terms.note: Apple-style single … is used in menus (存储为…); …… is tolerated in prose. ASCII punctuation inside code, URLs or placeholders is left alone.
